definitions.rho: rho r sigma = sum_i r i (sigma i)
definitions.weight: weight b sigma = product_i b i (sigma i)
definitions.forward: forwardMatrix b r i j = Polynomial.monomial (r i j) (b i j)
definitions.reverse: reverseMatrix r c i j = Polynomial.monomial (c i - r i j) 1

fixed_development_obligations.forward_determinant_expansion: (forwardMatrix b r).det = sum_sigma Polynomial.monomial (rho r sigma) (signCoeff sigma * weight b sigma)
fixed_development_obligations.reverse_determinant_expansion: (hcap : forall i j, r i j <= c i) -> (reverseMatrix r c).det = sum_sigma Polynomial.monomial (centralIndex c - rho r sigma) (signCoeff sigma)
fixed_development_obligations.permutation_sign_square: forall sigma, signCoeff sigma * signCoeff sigma = 1
fixed_development_obligations.central_determinant_pairing: (hcap : forall i j, r i j <= c i) -> (hinj : Function.Injective (rho r)) -> ((forwardMatrix b r).det * (reverseMatrix r c).det).coeff (centralIndex c) = sum_sigma weight b sigma

allowable_supporting_obligations: Finite-sum diagonal coefficient pairing with explicit injectivity, label bounds and sign-square assumptions
Monomial products and row-indexed Leibniz expansion via det_transpose and det_apply'
rho bounds and finite sum of natural-number complementary labels
Base-n label injection via the previously verified n38 indexed label theorem, when feasible
